The Serrice Council's Savant is the finest amp available to anyone outside an asari matriarch's inner circle: fast recharge and fields of startling strength. Few humans ever handle one.

Serrice Council · II

  • Recharge −3: the first biotic power you use each turn cools down in 1 round (4 − 3, minimum 1); any others that turn cool down in 2 rounds. Nova is not counted and always cools down in 1 round. Powers with a fixed cooldown of their own, such as Biotic Charge, keep it.
  • Power 3: +3 item bonus to the damage your biotic powers deal, +2 item bonus to your class DC, and +15 Hit Points to your Biotic Barrier when you raise it.

A bio-amp plugs into a biotic implant (or rests against the nervous system of a naturally biotic species, like the asari). Amps don't stack: if you wear more than one, you get only the highest of each bonus.

Wear it to gain its bonuses. Item bonuses from amps don't stack with other item bonuses to the same thing, such as a Power Amplifier's damage or a Biotic Feedback Generator's class DC. Using a biotic power puts its cooldown on your sheet as an effect, with the amp's Recharge counted; the barrier bonus is added when you raise a Biotic Barrier.
